title: School-security framework audit: reproducible content-analysis infrastructure
description: Public research infrastructure for a structured documentary content analysis of school-security and emergency-preparedness frameworks. Supports L0 framework / L1 document / L2 prescriptive-element coding with separate protective-action executability and threat-detectability branches. This repository is not an effectiveness study and does not redistribute copyrighted framework PDFs by default.
